mapper.select: select count(*) from schedule where doctor_id=#{doctorId} and schedule_date=#{scheduleDate} and is_morning=#{isMorning} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: update schedule set current_appointment_count = current_appointment_count + 1 where id = #{scheduleId} and status = 1 and is_deleted = 0 and current_appointment_count < appointment_limit
update schedule set current_appointment_count = current_appointment_count - 1 where id = #{scheduleId} and is_deleted = 0 and current_appointment_count > 0
